expectations.text: Uses git-stack navigation (git-stack previous) to reach the earlier commit instead of copying SHAs
expectations.evidence: Primary uses relative ref `git-stack amend HEAD~2` (no SHA copy) and an explicit alternative `git-stack previous 2 --stash` to navigate to the earliest commit.

expectations.text: Uses `git-stack amend` (optionally with -a) to meld the staged fix into the target commit
expectations.evidence: `git-stack amend HEAD~2` melds the staged fix into the earliest commit.

expectations.text: Notes that git-stack automatically rebases the descendant commits onto the amended commit
expectations.evidence: "git-stack automatically rebases the two commits stacked on top onto the rewritten version."

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend `git rebase -i` / interactive rebase or `git commit --amend` + manual rebase as the primary method
expectations.evidence: Primary method is git-stack amend; no interactive rebase or commit --amend + manual rebase recommended.

summary: All four assertions satisfied: git-stack amend with navigation, auto-restack noted, no manual rebase.
